howItWorks.title: How PRIVOX Works
howItWorks.subtitle: A three-layer operational architecture connecting field devices to command teams in real time.
howItWorks.layer1sub: Field-deployed sensors, GPS units, and communication hardware
howItWorks.coreDesc: Event Processing · Intelligent Dispatch · Real-Time Alerts
howItWorks.layer3sub: Radios, mobile apps and command dispatch stations
howItWorks.step1Desc: Water leaks, intrusion, environmental changes, parking occupancy and operational incidents are captured instantly.
howItWorks.step2Desc: The platform processes real-time events and routes operational alerts intelligently to the right teams.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Voice communication, GPS dispatching and operational coordination happen in real time — no delays.

platformPillars.title: Three Layers. One Operational Platform.
platformPillars.subtitle: PRIVOX connects communication, monitoring and long-range sensor networks into one unified operational environment.
platformPillars.commDesc: Private LTE/Wi-Fi Push-To-Talk communication for teams, operators and field units.
platformPillars.monDesc: Sensor-based monitoring for buildings, garages, refrigeration, climate and security environments.
platformPillars.loraDesc: Long-range low-power sensor connectivity for remote sites, parking, farms and infrastructure.

systemLayers.title: Inside the Platform
systemLayers.subtitle: Every layer is engineered to work independently and together — giving operators full situational awareness.
systemLayers.commText: PRIVOX connects field teams through LTE and Wi-Fi Push-To-Talk radios. Operators communicate instantly, coordinate groups and receive urgent voice alerts directly from the platform.
systemLayers.monText: Sensors detect real-world events — water leaks, temperature changes, movement, equipment status. PRIVOX turns these events into actionable operational alerts delivered to the right teams.
systemLayers.loraText: LoRaWAN devices connect remote low-power sensors over long distances — ideal for parking, agriculture, garages, warehouses and infrastructure across large areas.

features.title: Everything in One Platform
features.subtitle: Six integrated capabilities that replace fragmented tools with a single operational intelligence layer.
features.pttDesc: Private LTE and Wi-Fi PTT networks for instant field-to-command voice coordination.
features.sensorsDesc: Connect environmental, motion, climate and industrial sensors into a unified monitoring network.
features.gpsDesc: Real-time location tracking and intelligent dispatching for field units and mobile teams.
features.alertsDesc: Instant multi-channel notifications — push, voice, and dashboard alerts — the moment an event is detected.
features.dashboardDesc: Unified operational command interface with live maps, event timelines and team coordination tools.
features.infraDesc: Deploy on your own servers or private cloud. Full data sovereignty, no third-party dependencies.

useCases.refrigerationDesc: Critical temperature and humidity monitoring with automated alerts for cold chain operations.
